about: Steps by an authority that name a company (inspection, investigation, decision, court ruling), curated by hand. They describe the company, never a specific contract, and are never scored. A supplier without an entry has not been checked.
method: Only the authority's own announcement (or a verbatim copy when its site is unreachable) is used; media analysis is not. A company is matched by the national identifier declared in the procurement notices when the announcement's company name is the same company; the basis is recorded per entry.

suppliers.name: Metaminds SA
suppliers.identityBasis: Named “Metaminds SA” in the Council's release; the TED notices declare the winner “METAMINDS” with CUI 34770594.

proceedings.wording: On 13 June 2024 the Romanian Competition Council announced unannounced inspections at 14 IT&C companies, this one among them, in an investigation into possible rigging of public tenders for Cisco equipment since at least 2019: the Council said it had indications that such tenders were shared among bidders with the supplier’s support. It said the inspections do not prejudge the companies’ guilt. No later decision was found in searches on 15 October 2026 (the Council’s decision list could not be read).

suppliers.name: Union Co SRL
suppliers.identityBasis: Named “UNION CO S.R.L.” with CUI 16591086 in the Council's decision; the TED notices declare the winner “UNION CO” with the same CUI.

proceedings.wording: In Decision 225 of 29 October 2024 the Romanian Competition Council found that Union Co SRL and Safety Technology SRL shared the market between them (a concerted practice, art. 5(1)(c) of the Competition Law) in the tender run by Baia Mare municipality in 2021 for “EDU BM Educație Digitală” (tablets and other devices for schools). It fined this company 661,093.16 lei, reduced to 396,655.90 lei for admitting the infringement if the company does not challenge the decision in court. The non-confidential decision was published on 15 July 2025. No court challenge by either company was found on the courts' portal on 17 October 2026.
